paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-2 evaluation.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of different implementations of the QA-2 evaluation, specifically focusing on the performance of EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our) models. The horizontal axis displays the model names, listed alphabetically from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the percentage score, ranging from 1.4 to 95.7, with a linear scale. The value axis is labeled “Score (%)” and contains tick marks every 10 percentage points, beginning at 1.4 and ending at 95.7. The tallest bar, representing RedWhale (our), has a value of 95.7, with a partially incorrect section colored pale blue and a completely incorrect section colored light blue. The bar for EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 has a value of 92.9, with a partially correct section colored purple and a completely incorrect section colored pale blue. The bar for EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 has a value of 2.9 and a completely incorrect section colored pale blue, while RedWhale (our) has a value of 1.4 and a partially incorrect section colored lilac. All bars are unshaded and similarly sized, presenting a straightforward comparison of the numerical scores for each model.
